comparator.name: Bachelor Mechanical Engineering
comparator.sourceNotes: The current 2026–2027 Mechanical Engineering after-revision PER Articles 3.3–3.5 and programme appendices were freshly retrieved and inspected on 8 October 2026. Article 3.3 establishes English instruction, correcting normalized NLD-only metadata while preserving raw NLD provenance. The ordinary degree is core 125 including 4WC00 Bachelor Final Project 10, ITEC 10 and genuine free space 45. The 28 positions total 180: year one core 55 + ITEC 5; year two core 40 + electives 20; year three core 30 including project + ITEC 5 + electives 25. Two restricted third-year core options are instantiated as the first alternatives in the displayed Q3 and Q4 groups:4CC50 Design Principles for Precision ME and 4CBLC30 Mechanical Design Project, each 5. Selection is independent of UCR fit; no named graduation route is invented and all eight alternatives are not universally compulsory. Optional summer 4WC30 Precision in High-tech Systems is distinct from selected 4CC50 and is not added. PPD is embedded in existing credits; seven MyFuture points, five Studium Generale activities for ITEC and mandatory CANS(RSI), HSE and ICT training do not add EC. Free 45 requires at least 30 at levels 2/3 including 15 at level 3, approval and non-overlap. BEP entry requires at least 120 credits and all compulsory first-year components. It may be taken in any quarter, over two quarters with other work or as a single-quarter block; exact future scheduling and admission remain conditions. No new UCR judgment is made.
